  34  def chisq_accum_bin(chisq, q):
  35      """Accumulate squared magnitude of q into chisq time series in JAX."""
  36      _ensure_x64()
  37      q_arr = to_jax(q)
  38      power = q_arr.real ** 2 + q_arr.imag ** 2
  39      if isinstance(chisq, JAXArrayData):
  40          chisq.set_array(chisq.array + power)
  41      elif hasattr(chisq, "_data") and isinstance(chisq._data, JAXArrayData):
  42          chisq._data.set_array(chisq._data.array + power)
  43      elif hasattr(chisq, "data") and isinstance(chisq.data, JAXArrayData):
  44          chisq.data.set_array(chisq.data.array + power)
  45      else:
  46          try:
  47              chisq.data[:] += np.asarray(power)
  48          except Exception:
  49              chisq[:] += np.asarray(power)

  57  def _array_is_cpu(arr):
  58      """Return whether an array is on CPU (including ordinary NumPy arrays)."""
  59      dev = getattr(arr, "device", None)
  60      if callable(dev):
  61          dev = dev()
  62      if dev is None:
  63          buffer = getattr(arr, "device_buffer", None)
  64          if buffer is not None:
  65              dev = getattr(buffer, "device", None)
  66              if callable(dev):
  67                  dev = dev()
  68      platform = getattr(dev, "platform", None)
  69      return platform in (None, "cpu")

  72  def _point_chisq_cpu(arr, shifts, bins, n_time, base_k=0):
  73      """Evaluate full or cropped CPU correlations with accurate Fourier sums."""
  74      return _point_chisq_numpy(arr, shifts, bins, n_time, base_k=base_k)

  76  
  77  def _require_point_chisq_x64():
  78      if not jax.config.jax_enable_x64:
  79          raise RuntimeError(
  80              "JAX point chi-square requires 64-bit integer phase arithmetic. "
  81              "Set PYCBC_JAX_ENABLE_X64=1 (the default) or use the CPU scheme."
  82          )
  83  
  84  
  85  def _time_shift_phase(n_slice, kmin, points, n_time, dtype):
  86      """Form periodic phases without losing bits in large frequency/time products."""
  87      _require_point_chisq_x64()
  88      k = jnp.arange(n_slice, dtype=jnp.int64) + jnp.asarray(kmin, jnp.int64)
  89      cycles = (k[:, None] * points[None, :].astype(jnp.int64)) % jnp.asarray(
  90          n_time, jnp.int64
  91      )
  92      angle = cycles.astype(jnp.float64) * (2 * jnp.pi / n_time)
  93      return jnp.exp(1j * angle).astype(dtype)

  96  @functools.partial(jax.jit, static_argnames=("chunk_size",))
  97  def _shift_sum_gpu_core(
  98      arr_slice, kmin_f, pts_chunk, bin_rel_indices, n_time_f, chunk_size=16
  99  ):
 100      """JIT-compiled GPU power chisq prefix sum across frequency bins on corr_slice."""
 101      n_slice = arr_slice.shape[0]
 102      phases = _time_shift_phase(
 103          n_slice, kmin_f, pts_chunk, n_time_f, arr_slice.dtype
 104      )
 105      weighted = arr_slice[:, None] * phases
 106      C = jnp.cumsum(weighted, axis=0)
 107      C_padded = jnp.pad(C, ((1, 0), (0, 0)))
 108      edges = jnp.clip(bin_rel_indices, 0, n_slice)
 109      i0 = edges[:-1]
 110      i1 = edges[1:]
 111      zb = C_padded[i1] - C_padded[i0]
 112      power = jnp.sum(zb.real ** 2 + zb.imag ** 2, axis=0)
 113      return power

 116  @functools.partial(jax.jit, static_argnames=("chunk_size",))
 117  def _shift_sum_gpu_core_row(
 118      corr_tensor, row_idx, kmin_f, pts_chunk, bin_rel_indices, n_time_f, chunk_size=16
 119  ):
 120      """JIT-compiled GPU power chisq prefix sum indexing row on device."""
 121      arr_slice = corr_tensor[row_idx]
 122      n_slice = arr_slice.shape[0]
 123      phases = _time_shift_phase(
 124          n_slice, kmin_f, pts_chunk, n_time_f, arr_slice.dtype
 125      )
 126      weighted = arr_slice[:, None] * phases
 127      C = jnp.cumsum(weighted, axis=0)
 128      C_padded = jnp.pad(C, ((1, 0), (0, 0)))
 129      edges = jnp.clip(bin_rel_indices, 0, n_slice)
 130      i0 = edges[:-1]
 131      i1 = edges[1:]
 132      zb = C_padded[i1] - C_padded[i0]
 133      power = jnp.sum(zb.real ** 2 + zb.imag ** 2, axis=0)
 134      return power

 137  @functools.partial(jax.jit, static_argnames=("bucket_size",))
 138  def _batched_points_chisq_core(
 139      corr_tensor, row_indices, pts, bins_rel_all, kmin_f, n_time_f, bucket_size=256
 140  ):
 141      """JIT-compiled GPU batched power chisq prefix sum across all triggered points.
 142  
 143      Calculates time-shifted frequency bin sums for all points across all templates
 144      in parallel via vmap over points, executing in a single CUDA kernel.
 145      """
 146      n_slice = corr_tensor.shape[-1]
 147      def _point_chisq(row, pt, bin_rel):
 148          phases = _time_shift_phase(
 149              n_slice, kmin_f, jnp.reshape(pt, (1,)), n_time_f, row.dtype
 150          )[:, 0]
 151          weighted = row * phases
 152          C = jnp.cumsum(weighted)
 153          C_padded = jnp.pad(C, (1, 0))
 154          edges = jnp.clip(bin_rel, 0, n_slice)
 155          i0 = edges[:-1]
 156          i1 = edges[1:]
 157          zb = C_padded[i1] - C_padded[i0]
 158          return jnp.sum(zb.real ** 2 + zb.imag ** 2)
 159  
 160      rows = corr_tensor[row_indices]
 161      bins_pts = bins_rel_all[row_indices]
 162      return jax.vmap(_point_chisq)(rows, pts, bins_pts)

 165  def shift_sum(corr, points, bins):
 166      """Calculate time-shifted sum of FrequencySeries bins in JAX."""
 167      _ensure_x64()
 168      pts = np.asarray(points, dtype=np.int64)
 169      if len(pts) == 0:
 170          return np.array([], dtype=np.float32)
 171  
 172      use_row_indexing = (
 173          hasattr(corr, "_batch_tensor")
 174          and hasattr(corr, "_batch_pos")
 175          and corr._batch_tensor is not None
 176      )
 177  
 178      if use_row_indexing:
 179          arr = to_jax(corr._batch_tensor)
 180      else:
 181          arr = to_jax(corr)
 182      is_cpu = _array_is_cpu(arr)
 183  
 184      if is_cpu:
 185          if use_row_indexing:
 186              arr = arr[corr._batch_pos]
 187          arr_np = np.asarray(arr)
 188          base_k = int(getattr(corr, "_kmin", 0))
 189          n_time = int(getattr(corr, "_tlen", len(arr_np)))
 190          return _point_chisq_cpu(arr_np, pts, bins, n_time, base_k=base_k)
 191  
 192      _require_point_chisq_x64()
 193      if use_row_indexing:
 194          corr_tensor = to_jax(corr._batch_tensor)
 195          row_idx = int(corr._batch_pos)
 196          kmin = int(corr._kmin)
 197          n_time = int(corr._tlen)
 198      elif hasattr(corr, "_kmin") and hasattr(corr, "_tlen"):
 199          kmin = int(corr._kmin)
 200          n_time = int(corr._tlen)
 201          arr_slice = arr
 202      else:
 203          # Correlations contain the full complex FFT work vector, even
 204          # when represented by a FrequencySeries.
 205          n_time = len(arr)
 206          kmin = int(bins[0])
 207          kmax = int(bins[-1])
 208          arr_slice = arr[kmin:kmax]
 209  
 210      bin_indices = jnp.asarray(bins, dtype=jnp.int32)
 211      bin_rel = bin_indices - kmin
 212      kmin_f = float(kmin)
 213      n_time_f = float(n_time)
 214  
 215      pts_np = np.asarray(pts, dtype=np.int32)
 216      n_pts = len(pts_np)
 217      out_res = np.empty(n_pts, dtype=np.float32)
 218  
 219      offset = 0
 220      while offset < n_pts:
 221          rem = n_pts - offset
 222          if rem == 1:
 223              sz = 1
 224          elif rem == 2:
 225              sz = 2
 226          elif rem <= 4:
 227              sz = 4
 228          elif rem <= 8:
 229              sz = 8
 230          else:
 231              sz = 16
 232          chunk_slice = pts_np[offset:offset + min(rem, sz)]
 233          cur_len = len(chunk_slice)
 234          if cur_len < sz:
 235              buf = np.zeros(sz, dtype=np.int32)
 236              buf[:cur_len] = chunk_slice
 237              pts_j = jax.device_put(buf)
 238          else:
 239              pts_j = jax.device_put(chunk_slice)
 240          if use_row_indexing:
 241              res_j = _shift_sum_gpu_core_row(
 242                  corr_tensor, row_idx, kmin_f, pts_j, bin_rel, n_time_f, chunk_size=sz
 243              )
 244          else:
 245              res_j = _shift_sum_gpu_core(
 246                  arr_slice, kmin_f, pts_j, bin_rel, n_time_f, chunk_size=sz
 247              )
 248          out_res[offset:offset + cur_len] = np.asarray(res_j)[:cur_len]
 249          offset += cur_len
 250      return out_res

 253  def power_chisq_at_points_from_precomputed(
 254      corr, snr, snr_norm, bins, indices
 255  ):
 256      """Calculate chisq values at triggered points from precomputed products."""
 257      num_bins = len(bins) - 1
 258      chisq = shift_sum(corr, indices, bins)
 259      snr_arr = np.asarray(snr)
 260      return (
 261          (chisq * num_bins - (snr_arr.conj() * snr_arr).real)
 262          * (float(snr_norm) ** 2.0)
 263      )

 266  def power_chisq_bins_jax(
 267      htilde,
 268      num_bins,
 269      psd,
 270      low_frequency_cutoff=None,
 271      high_frequency_cutoff=None,
 272  ):
 273      """Calculate standard-backend-compatible bin edges for a JAX template."""
 274      from pycbc.filter.matchedfilter import get_cutoff_indices
 275  
 276      _ensure_x64()
 277      n_pts = (len(htilde) - 1) * 2
 278      delta_f = float(htilde.delta_f)
 279      kmin, kmax = get_cutoff_indices(
 280          low_frequency_cutoff, high_frequency_cutoff, delta_f, n_pts
 281      )
 282  
 283      from pycbc import scheme
 284      state = getattr(scheme.mgr, "state", None)
 285      target_dev = getattr(state, "jax_device", None)
 286  
 287      h_arr = to_jax(htilde, device=target_dev)
 288      psd_arr = to_jax(psd, device=target_dev)
 289  
 290      return _power_chisq_bins_numpy(
 291          h_arr, psd_arr, int(kmin), int(kmax), int(num_bins), delta_f
 292      )
 293  
 294  
 295  def _power_chisq_bins_numpy(h_arr, psd_arr, kmin, kmax, num_bins, delta_f):
 296      """Match the standard backend's cumulative power and discrete bin edges.
 297  
 298      A parallel single-precision scan changes bin boundaries in long templates.
 299      Compute these cached boundaries with the same serial accumulation and
 300      edge precision as sigmasq_series/power_chisq_bins_from_sigmasq_series.
 301      """
 302      h_slice = np.asarray(h_arr)[..., kmin:kmax]
 303      power = h_slice.real ** 2 + h_slice.imag ** 2
 304      power /= np.asarray(psd_arr)[kmin:kmax]
 305      cumulative = np.cumsum(power, axis=-1) * (4.0 * delta_f)
 306  
 307      def row_bins(row):
 308          edges = np.arange(num_bins) * row[-1] / num_bins
 309          bins = np.searchsorted(row, edges, side="right") + kmin
 310          return np.append(bins, kmax).astype(np.uint32)
 311  
 312      if cumulative.ndim == 1:
 313          return row_bins(cumulative)
 314      return np.stack([row_bins(row) for row in cumulative])
 315

 317  def batch_power_chisq_bins_jax(
 318      templates,
 319      num_bins,
 320      psd,
 321      low_frequency_cutoff=None,
 322      high_frequency_cutoff=None,
 323  ):
 324      """Calculate standard-backend-compatible bin edges for JAX template rows."""
 325      from pycbc.filter.matchedfilter import get_cutoff_indices
 326  
 327      _ensure_x64()
 328      n_pts = (len(templates[0]) - 1) * 2
 329      delta_f = float(templates[0].delta_f)
 330      kmin, kmax = get_cutoff_indices(
 331          low_frequency_cutoff, high_frequency_cutoff, delta_f, n_pts
 332      )
 333  
 334      from pycbc import scheme
 335      state = getattr(scheme.mgr, "state", None)
 336      target_dev = getattr(state, "jax_device", None)
 337  
 338      batch_tensor = getattr(templates, "_batch_tensor", None)
 339      if batch_tensor is None:
 340          tmpls_tensor = jnp.stack([to_jax(t, device=target_dev) for t in templates], axis=0)
 341      else:
 342          tmpls_tensor = to_jax(batch_tensor, device=target_dev)
 343  
 344      psd_arr = to_jax(psd, device=target_dev)
 345  
 346      return _power_chisq_bins_numpy(
 347          tmpls_tensor,
 348          psd_arr,
 349          int(kmin),
 350          int(kmax),
 351          int(num_bins),
 352          delta_f,
 353      )
 354

 356  def batch_power_chisq_jax(
 357      corr_tensor,
 358      batch_results,
 359      active_templates,
 360      psd,
 361      analyze_start,
 362      snr_threshold=None,
 363      power_chisq=None,
 364  ):
 365      """Batched evaluation of power chisq across all triggered templates in a segment.
 366  
 367      Computes time-shifted frequency bin sums for all triggered points across all
 368      templates simultaneously in a single JAX GPU kernel launch, replacing sequential
 369      per-template dispatch and synchronization loops.
 370  
 371      Returns:
 372          chisq_map: dict mapping act_pos -> (chisq_out, chisq_dof)
 373      """
 374      _ensure_x64()
 375      if corr_tensor is None or len(batch_results) == 0:
 376          return None
 377  
 378      psd_id = id(psd)
 379      b = len(active_templates)
 380  
 381      # 1. Gather bin edges for all active templates
 382      bins_list = []
 383      for tmpl in active_templates:
 384          b_edges = None
 385          # The canonical cache also validates template parameters; reusable
 386          # template buffers may retain edges belonging to a previous template.
 387          if power_chisq is not None and hasattr(power_chisq, "cached_chisq_bins"):
 388              b_edges = power_chisq.cached_chisq_bins(tmpl, psd)
 389          elif hasattr(tmpl, "_bin_cache") and psd_id in tmpl._bin_cache:
 390              b_edges = tmpl._bin_cache[psd_id]
 391          if b_edges is None:
 392              return None
 393          bins_list.append(b_edges)
 394  
 395      # Different bin counts require the caller's per-template scalar fallback.
 396      num_bins_set = set(len(b_edges) - 1 for b_edges in bins_list)
 397      if len(num_bins_set) != 1:
 398          return None
 399  
 400      num_bins = len(bins_list[0]) - 1
 401      dof = num_bins * 2 - 2
 402  
 403      # Retrieve correlation metadata
 404      corr_sample = None
 405      for res in batch_results:
 406          if res[2] is not None and hasattr(res[2], "_kmin"):
 407              corr_sample = res[2]
 408              break
 409      if corr_sample is None:
 410          return None
 411  
 412      kmin = int(corr_sample._kmin)
 413      tlen = int(corr_sample._tlen)
 414      kmin_f = float(kmin)
 415      n_time_f = float(tlen)
 416  
 417      # 2. Gather active trigger points across all templates
 418      chisq_map = {}
 419      points_to_compute = []
 420      total_points = 0
 421  
 422      for act_pos in range(b):
 423          snr, norm, corr, idx, snrv = batch_results[act_pos]
 424          n_idx = len(idx)
 425          if n_idx == 0:
 426              chisq_map[act_pos] = (
 427                  np.zeros(0, dtype=np.float32), np.repeat(dof, 0)
 428              )
 429              continue
 430  
 431          if snr_threshold is not None:
 432              above = abs(snrv * norm) > snr_threshold
 433              n_above = int(np.sum(above))
 434          else:
 435              above = np.ones(n_idx, dtype=bool)
 436              n_above = n_idx
 437  
 438          if n_above == 0:
 439              chisq_map[act_pos] = (
 440                  np.zeros(n_idx, dtype=np.float32),
 441                  np.repeat(dof, n_idx),
 442              )
 443              continue
 444  
 445          above_indices = (idx[above] + analyze_start).astype(np.int32)
 446          above_snrv = snrv[above]
 447          points_to_compute.append({
 448              "act_pos": act_pos,
 449              "above_indices": above_indices,
 450              "above_snrv": above_snrv,
 451              "norm": float(norm),
 452              "above_mask": above,
 453              "n_idx": n_idx,
 454              "n_above": n_above,
 455          })
 456          total_points += n_above
 457  
 458      if total_points == 0:
 459          return chisq_map
 460  
 461      # 3. Stack bins array for active templates and build flattened point arrays
 462      bins_arr = np.array(bins_list, dtype=np.int32)
 463  
 464      all_rows = np.empty(total_points, dtype=np.int32)
 465      all_pts = np.empty(total_points, dtype=np.int32)
 466  
 467      offset = 0
 468      for item in points_to_compute:
 469          n_ab = item["n_above"]
 470          all_rows[offset:offset + n_ab] = item["act_pos"]
 471          all_pts[offset:offset + n_ab] = item["above_indices"]
 472          offset += n_ab
 473  
 474      # CPU correlations use the shared accurate Fourier sums. Grouping points
 475      # by template avoids a padded JAX bucket and keeps cropped rows intact.
 476      if _array_is_cpu(corr_tensor):
 477          corr_np = np.asarray(corr_tensor)
 478          all_shift_sums = np.empty(total_points, dtype=np.float32)
 479          offset = 0
 480          for item in points_to_compute:
 481              act_pos = item["act_pos"]
 482              n_ab = item["n_above"]
 483              if corr_np.ndim == 2:
 484                  row = corr_np[act_pos]
 485              else:
 486                  row = np.asarray(batch_results[act_pos][2].data)
 487              vals = _point_chisq_cpu(
 488                  row, item["above_indices"], bins_arr[act_pos], tlen, base_k=kmin
 489              )
 490              all_shift_sums[offset:offset + n_ab] = vals
 491              offset += n_ab
 492      else:
 493          _require_point_chisq_x64()
 494          bins_rel_all = jax.device_put(bins_arr - kmin)
 495          # 4. Bucketed JAX execution
 496          bucket_sizes = (32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096)
 497          chosen_bucket = None
 498          for bsz in bucket_sizes:
 499              if total_points <= bsz:
 500                  chosen_bucket = bsz
 501                  break
 502          if chosen_bucket is None:
 503              chosen_bucket = int(2 ** np.ceil(np.log2(total_points)))
 504  
 505          r_buf = np.zeros(chosen_bucket, dtype=np.int32)
 506          p_buf = np.zeros(chosen_bucket, dtype=np.int32)
 507          r_buf[:total_points] = all_rows
 508          p_buf[:total_points] = all_pts
 509  
 510          r_dev = jax.device_put(r_buf)
 511          p_dev = jax.device_put(p_buf)
 512  
 513          res_dev = _batched_points_chisq_core(
 514              corr_tensor, r_dev, p_dev, bins_rel_all, kmin_f, n_time_f, bucket_size=chosen_bucket
 515          )
 516          all_shift_sums = np.asarray(res_dev[:total_points])
 517  
 518      # 5. Distribute results back to each template
 519      offset = 0
 520      for item in points_to_compute:
 521          n_ab = item["n_above"]
 522          act_pos = item["act_pos"]
 523          n_idx = item["n_idx"]
 524          norm = item["norm"]
 525          above_mask = item["above_mask"]
 526          above_snrv = item["above_snrv"]
 527  
 528          shifts = all_shift_sums[offset:offset + n_ab]
 529          offset += n_ab
 530  
 531          chisq_vals = (shifts * num_bins - (above_snrv.conj() * above_snrv).real) * (norm ** 2.0)
 532          chisq_out = np.zeros(n_idx, dtype=np.float32)
 533          chisq_out[above_mask] = chisq_vals.astype(np.float32)
 534          chisq_dof = np.repeat(dof, n_idx)
 535  
 536          chisq_map[act_pos] = (chisq_out, chisq_dof)
 537  
 538      return chisq_map
